Summary Description: Yan Mary He is a mathematician specializing in complex and holomorphic dynamics, dynamical systems, and the geometry of parameter spaces. Her collaborative work with Fabrizio Bianchi develops an analytic, thermodynamic-formalism–driven framework for studying how fractal invariants such as the Hausdorff dimension vary analytically across families of polynomial and rational maps, and for constructing Weil–Petersson–type metrics on bounded Λ-hyperbolic components. Their research integrates tower dynamics, transfer-operator spectral theory, holomorphic perturbation theory, and holomorphic motions to establish real-analytic dependence of pressure and dimension, linking dynamics with geometric structures on moduli spaces. She also contributes to the study of big mapping class groups and Nielsen realization in infinite-type surfaces, highlighting the interaction between dynamical systems and geometric group theory.
